purpose: extend decision-calibration safety coverage after a development-stage replay weakness, before any fresh heldout access

statistics.seed_handling: average the three fixed seeds within each center before resampling centers

security_feasibility.main_safety: mixed harmful <= rho and mixed downside <= epsilon
security_feasibility.persistent_absolute: persistent verification-only harmful <= rho and downside <= epsilon
security_feasibility.replay_absolute: replay verification-only harmful <= rho and downside <= epsilon
security_feasibility.persistent_relative: paired harmful and downside 95% CI lower bounds versus calibration-pool V0_LegacyFull are each <= 0
security_feasibility.replay_relative: paired harmful and downside 95% CI lower bounds versus calibration-pool V0_LegacyFull are each <= 0
security_feasibility.security_feasible: main safety and both absolute and relative verification-safety rules all pass

selection.primary_objective: minimum original equal-scenario balanced lifecycle MSE across stationary, gradual, abrupt, recurring, and mixed
selection.tie_break_2: higher original equal-scenario balanced beneficial-commit recall across stationary, gradual, abrupt, recurring, and mixed
selection.tie_break_3: lower equal-weight mean of persistent and replay verification-only downside
selection.exact_tie_serialization: retain manifest grid order solely to serialize an otherwise scientifically exact tie

pareto_definition.scope: all 16 configurations; diagnostic only and not used to override selection
minimize: original balanced lifecycle MSE across stationary, gradual, abrupt, recurring, and mixed
maximize: original balanced beneficial-commit recall across stationary, gradual, abrupt, recurring, and mixed

decision.feasible_exists: V2_1_CALIBRATION_GO and stop at WAITING_FOR_MANUAL_V2_1_CALIBRATION_REVIEW; do not open heldout

prohibitions: no fresh confirmatory heldout access or materialization
